description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a team focused on providing high-quality rehabilitative care to patients, helping them regain independence and improve their quality of life.As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, implementing treatment plans and assisting patients with therapeutic activities. We are looking for a compassionate and skilled professional eager to make a significant impact in a supportive environment. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to be part of a valued therapy team.
requirements: Valid Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) license in Florida
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Commitment to patient-centered care and teamwork
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.
